messages.subject: Error deploying app
parts:
Hi,

In order to test out shinyApps, I created a new app, named it testShinyappsIO, and copied the example code from the intro page.
It runs fine locally under runApp().

When I try to deploy I get the following error:

> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...Update application currently deployed at
http://tapo.shinyapps.io/testShinyappsIO? [Y/n] y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...Error in FUN(X[[1L]], ...) :
  No method for converting packageDescription to JSON

Here's my session into:
> sessionInfo()
R version 3.1.0 (2014-04-10)
Platform: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (64-bit)

locale:
[1] C

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    

other attached packages:
[1] shinyapps_0.3.55 ggplot2_1.0.0    shiny_0.10.0   

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
 [1] MASS_7.3-31      RCurl_1.95-4.2   RJSONIO_0.98-1   Rcpp_0.11.1    
 [5] bitops_1.0-6     caTools_1.17     colorspace_1.2-4 digest_0.6.4   
 [9] grid_3.1.0       gtable_0.1.2     htmltools_0.2.4  httpuv_1.3.0   
[13] labeling_0.2     munsell_0.4.2    plyr_1.8.1       proto_0.3-10   
[17] reshape2_1.4     scales_0.2.4     stringr_0.6.2    tools_3.1.0    
[21] xtable_1.7-3   
>

When looking in my dashboard, I can see that the app has been created, but the status is "pending".

Did I miss something?

Thanks for a great tool!
Thomas
